_comment: Chapter 5 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F24, a payoff: the clerk's confession from chapter 3 (the soldiers lay down their arms, potions) or a fight (-20 HP).

text.zh_TW: 收集者的隊長帶著一排士兵擋住了走廊。「放下武器，小鬼。主人要的是你，不是他們。」
text.en: The Collectors' captain blocks the corridor with a line of soldiers. "Drop your weapon, brat. The Master wants you, not them."

text.zh_TW: 凱展開書記寫的供詞：「主人的命令：收完村子的孩子，接下來收『收集者』自己的孩子。」士兵們你看我、我看你。一把劍落地，又一把……
text.en: Kai unrolls the clerk's confession. "The Master's orders: when the villages' children are taken, take the Collectors' own children next." The soldiers look at one another. One sword hits the floor. Then another...

text.zh_TW: 士兵們衝了過來。你和凱背靠背打出一條路，身上多了好幾道傷。
text.en: The soldiers charge. Back to back, you and Kai fight your way through, and you don't come out unscathed.
